OQ-3 (062 vs GBL-123): GBL-123 already performs most 062 DDL under ISS-503 guard; design keeps both idempotent, 062 adds data-migration pre-flight + explicit composite-index drops.

OQ-4 (storage_mode after SPT-03): routing stops branching on storage_mode; column kept for provisioning.zig/tenant_migration.zig; iss107/tnt_schema_isolation routing tests updated by SPT-04; whether to delete resolveAndCacheStorageMode needs confirmation.

OQ-5 (migration scope headers): 061-063 use -- scope: public with dynamic %I-interpolated DDL (migration 069 precedent); confirm the public-scope misclassification guard accepts them without a runner change.
